title: Fit an inference path to a real request envelope
description: Change request shape, model tier, concurrency, batching, and prefix reuse. Watch prefill, decode, and KV-memory constraints move together.
notice: All rates are synthetic teaching profiles. Benchmark the complete model bundle on the exact runtime, hardware, prompt distribution, and quality target before release.

scenarios.label: Interactive support chat
scenarios.brief: Moderate context, short answers, and a strict first-token target.

scenarios.label: Long document analysis
scenarios.brief: A large prompt makes prefill and per-request KV memory the dominant risks.

scenarios.label: Offline batch extraction
scenarios.brief: First-token latency is relaxed, but high concurrency can exhaust memory or slow decoding.

profiles.label: Compact tier
profiles.detail: Lower quality ceiling with high token throughput and a small weight footprint.

profiles.label: Balanced tier
profiles.detail: A middle teaching profile for quality, latency, and memory.

profiles.label: Large tier
profiles.detail: Higher modeled task quality with slower token service and heavier weights and KV state.
